record.summary: The independently verified fourfold full-688 backward-adjoint result is finite at OOF final MSE 3.233766009119748e-8, a 0.008355853% regression versus J's 3.2334958229470984e-8. Its maximum per-network MSE is 3.3816765796841085e-7, so both the frozen mean and maximum gates fail. Fold direction splits 2–2, 98.699% of paired movement cancels, and all four >1e-7 breaches survive; this free backward feature path does not impose a globally consistent residual smoother.
